purpose: Machine-checkable form of the 'Do not over-route when' column for Tier 1 capabilities. Each entry keeps the source prose verbatim and states the predicates that must hold before routing that capability would be over-routing.

capabilities.label: Intent routing
capabilities.over_route_when_prose: The host already has an equivalent thin control plane

skip_when.rationale: This exclusion describes the host, not the task record. It is skipped only when the caller declares the host fact, never inferred from a missing field.

capabilities.label: Debugging
capabilities.over_route_when_prose: The cause and exact edit are already proven

skip_when.rationale: A recorded discover activity with no declared unknown-cause means the cause was already established in this record, so a debug pass would re-derive it.

capabilities.label: Code review
capabilities.over_route_when_prose: The edit is mechanical, local, and fully covered by a narrow check

skip_when.rationale: All three clauses of the source sentence must hold: one scoped item, no declared cross-boundary uncertainty, and passing evidence already covering every acceptance item.

capabilities.label: Verification
capabilities.over_route_when_prose: Never omit when claiming fixed, passing, ready, or complete

capabilities.label: Architecture impact
capabilities.over_route_when_prose: The change is isolated and has no meaningful boundary impact

skip_when.rationale: Reads 'isolated' as one scoped item and 'no meaningful boundary impact' as no assessed external-effect or reversibility dimension. Both bounds require the record to answer the question first, so an empty record cannot satisfy them vacuously.
